name: GitLab Platform
description: Protects against destructive GitLab platform operations like deleting projects, \ releases, protected branches, and webhooks.

destructive_patterns.name: glab-repo-delete
destructive_patterns.description: glab repo delete permanently deletes a GitLab project.

destructive_patterns.name: glab-repo-archive
destructive_patterns.description: glab repo archive makes a GitLab project read-only.

destructive_patterns.name: glab-release-delete
destructive_patterns.description: glab release delete removes GitLab releases.

destructive_patterns.name: glab-variable-delete
destructive_patterns.description: glab variable delete removes GitLab CI/CD variables.

destructive_patterns.name: glab-api-delete-project
destructive_patterns.description: glab api DELETE /projects/* deletes a GitLab project.

destructive_patterns.name: glab-api-delete-release
destructive_patterns.description: glab api DELETE releases removes GitLab releases.

destructive_patterns.name: glab-api-delete-variable
destructive_patterns.description: glab api DELETE variables removes CI/CD variables.

destructive_patterns.name: glab-api-delete-protected-branch
destructive_patterns.description: glab api DELETE protected_branches removes branch protections.

destructive_patterns.name: glab-api-delete-hook
destructive_patterns.description: glab api DELETE hooks removes GitLab webhooks.

destructive_patterns.name: gitlab-rails-runner-destructive
destructive_patterns.description: gitlab-rails runner destructive operations can remove data.

destructive_patterns.name: gitlab-rake-destructive
destructive_patterns.description: gitlab-rake destructive maintenance tasks can delete or replace data.
